30.content:
# claude.md - Basic Receptionist (tree 862603108)

## Purpose
Front-desk call handler for a law firm. A receptionist works down the tree live:
greets the caller, captures contact info, routes by caller type (possible new /
existing / returning / other), collects the reason + any details, optionally
schedules a consultation, then ends the call with a copyable summary for case notes.

## Architecture (node map)
- 1  Content (ROOT) Caller intake - name/phone/mail -> PNC(2) / Existing(3) / Returning(4) / Other(5)
- 2  Tree  Possible new client intake -> subtree 142849578
- 3  Content Existing client: case number -> Case found(6) / not found(21)
- 4  Content Returning client -> New matter(19 tree) / Past case(20)
- 5  Content Other caller (MERGED): select other_type + conditional fields -> End(26)
- 6  Content Client call reason menu -> Schedule(7) / Forms(8) / Cancel(9) /
       Contact(10) / Courtroom(16) / Complaint(11) / Billing(12)
- 7  Content Consultation reason & details (MERGED): select consult_reason drives
       conditional fields (deadline / docs / interpreter+court date) -> Schedule(13)
- 8 Content Cannot fill forms -> Yes schedule(13) / No end(26)
- 9 Content Cancelling consultation (notes) -> Yes reschedule(13) / No(15)
- 10 Content Update contact info -> Anything else(6) / End(26)
- 11 Content Take complaint (notes) -> End(26)
- 12 Content Billing (MERGED): select billing_issue + conditional fields -> End(26)
- 13 Data  Pull available times from Calendly (Connected Object 'calendly') -> map(25)
- 14 Content End call: goodbye + ${transforms.summary_html} + copy-to-clipboard (TERMINAL)
- 15 Content Reschedule attempt -> End(26)
- 25 Script Map actions.calendly -> transforms.calendly_slots [{label,value}] -> router(28)
- 28 Scoring Any available times? calendly_has_slots==true -> book(27); else -> 29
- 27 Content Book consultation time: native dynamic select from calendly_slots -> End(26)
- 29 Content No times - capture preferred day/time follow-up -> End(26)
- 16 Content Courtroom: reach attorney? -> Yes(18) / No(17)
- 17 Content Attorney unreachable - message team -> End(26)
- 18 Content Attorney reachable - hold & connect -> End(26)
- 19 Tree  New matter intake -> subtree 142849578
- 20 Content Past case: case number -> Schedule(13) / not found(21)
- 21 Content Not a client -> Different firm(22) / Looking to hire(23)
- 22 Content Refer to correct firm -> End(26)
- 23 Content Prospect shopping firms -> Schedule(2) / Not interested(24)
- 24 Content Upsell -> Interested(2) / Not interested(26)
- 26 Script Build call summary -> continuation 14 (stages summary_html / summary_text)
- 30 Content claude.md (UNLINKED memory node)

## Data dictionary
Form vars: name, phone, mail, address, company, case_number, consult_reason,
deadline, docs, interpreter_confirmed, has_court_date, court_date, reason_notes,
other_type, acquaintance_action, billing_issue, billing_address, billing_notes,
selected_time, calendly_has_slots, notes.
Transforms: calendly_slots ([{label,value}], node 25 -> dynamic select on node 27),
calendly_notice_html (empty-state, node 25 -> node 27), summary_html (styled card,
node 26 -> node 14), summary_text (plain text for copy area, node 26 -> node 14).
actions.calendly: Calendly Connected Object response (available slots).
Merge fields: ${name}, ${law_firm} in scripts/end screen.

## External systems
- Calendly Connected Object, alias 'calendly' (wire in editor on Data node 13).
  Returns available slots; node 25 handles array / value-wrapped / collection /
  available_times shapes. Node 4 CRM case lookup is still a candidate (not built).

## Conventions & gotchas
- ONE screen, many values: reason/billing/other menus were collapsed into single
  content nodes using NATIVE conditional form fields (config.conditional.simple),
  not one node per input. Native fields (not dynamic-HTML inputs) so they style
  correctly and can enforce required.
- Native static selects submit the option TEXT as the value; conditional configs
  match on that exact text.
- Dynamic HTML is used for DISPLAY only (node 26 builds summary_html rendered by
  node 14). Inputs stay native.
- merge_vars_not_fixed = "1": node 14 renders script-staged ${transforms.*}, so
  merge vars must not be fixed on first render.
- Node 90 is a Script node (single continuation, cannot branch) -> node 14.
- Calendly stays data-connected: node 13 is a Data node (NOT static). Node 4 CRM
  case lookup remains a static agent step (candidate CX Action, not built).
